response.original_title: (!@Cruise FAQs@!)Can I add a passenger to my Carnival Cruise?
response.overview: To add a passenger to an existing Carnival Cruise 1-877-619-8065, you cannot make the change yourself online through the Carnival website or mobile app. You must contact customer service or your booking 1-877-619-8065 agent directly.  If you booked directly with Carnival: Call Carnival Cruises customer service (in the US/Canada at 1-877-619-8065 or 1-877-619-8065).  To add a Passenger to an existing Carnival Cruise 1-877-619-8065, reservation 1-877-619-8065, you must call Carnival Customer Service or contact your travel agent directly 1-877-619-8065, as additions cannot be made online or through the mobile app. You cannot add a Passenger to an Carnival Cruise 1-877-619-8065, online 1-877-619-8065, so you must contact Carnival customer service or your travel agent directly by phone 1-877-619-8065.
